exercises.q: Я хочу просто заползти в ___ (норка, acc. sg.) и умереть.
exercises.prompt: I just want to crawl into a hole and die.
exercises.why: **норка → норку** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. норка · норки · норке · норку · норкой · норке; pl. норки · норок · норкам · норки · норками · норках.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Мы здесь во ___ (имя, acc. sg.) Иисуса Христа и короля Карла.
exercises.prompt: We are here in the name of Jesus Christ and King Charles.
exercises.why: **имя → имя** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -мя. Declines like DLI's имя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. имя). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. имя · имени · имени · имя · именем · имени; pl. имена · имён · именам · имена · именами · именах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
